title: Tusk project settings
description: Project settings for the Tusk editor that a team shares by committing this file. Tusk keeps keys it doesn't know as they are.

$schema.description: The JSON schema for this file.

indexExclude.description: Folders the PHP index and Mago skip, relative to the project. `*` matches within a folder name, and `**` any number of folders.

debugPathMappings.description: Where the project is on the server, for code that runs in Docker or on another machine: comma-separated entries, each `/server/path` (the project folder) or `/server/path=local/path`. A local path without a leading / is inside the project. Empty when PHP runs on this Mac.

debugExceptions.description: When the debugger pauses on exceptions.

pause.description: Whether to pause on exceptions at all.

classes.description: Exception classes to pause on, with their subclasses. Empty pauses on every exception and error.

uncaughtOnly.description: Pause only on exceptions that nothing catches.

skip.description: Path patterns, relative to the project, where a thrown exception doesn't pause, such as vendor/**.

debugWatches.description: Watch expressions the debugger evaluates each time it pauses.

breakpoints.description: Line breakpoints by file, relative to the project: pairs of a line number and the breakpoint's options.

condition.description: A PHP expression; the breakpoint pauses only when it's true.

hitCondition.description: Pause on a hit count, such as `>= 3` or `% 2`.

logMessage.description: Log this message instead of pausing. `{$expression}` inserts a value.

dockerService.description: The Docker Compose service that runs tests, Artisan, and Tinker. Empty runs them on the host.

databaseConnections.description: Saved database connections. URLs never hold passwords here: each person's password stays in their Keychain.

url.description: The connection URL without a password, such as mysql://user@host:3306/database, pgsql://…, sqlite:database/other.sqlite, or redis://host:6379/0.

formatters.description: The formatter and format on save for each language group: php, blade, js (JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue), css, json, markdown, and yaml.

use.description: The formatter: auto, a specific one, builtin (Monaco's own), or none.

onSave.description: Whether saving formats the file. Without it, the Format files when saving setting decides.

phpInterpreter.description: The PHP program this project uses instead of the one in Settings > Tools, such as /opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.3/bin/php.

databaseSsh.description: The SSH destination each database connection goes through, by connection name. The empty name is .env's connection.
